prereq.p: You must have an MS Office product open.

step.cmd: Click Connect and the Manage Connections window is displayed.
In the Create a new connection section, enter the first name and last name — as they are stored in Salesforce — of a user with a chatter license and click login.salesforce.com or test.salesforce.com.
Click Authorize and a Salesforce login window is displayed, enter your credentials and click Login.
If you are connecting to Salesforce via X-Author for Chatter for the first time, you may need to click Allow to continue.

result.p: The X-Author ribbon options are enabled and you can now log in to Chatter, Check-In and Check-Out files, or additionally, display the Translate pane when logging into Word.

postreq.p: Once you have configured connections for multiple users, you can select Switch Connection to change to someone else.
